mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a weakening in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.
